extracted.intended_audience: readers of Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung (FAZ.NET); German-speaking online news consumers
extracted.subtask_description: Front-page listing / curation of news items for an online national newspaper, grouping headlines, short teasers and section headings (Politics, Economy, Sport, Culture, etc.) to guide readers to full articles. The page aggregates topical stories, liveblogs, opinion pieces and multimedia for daily news consumption.
